sections.title: Office banter
lines: Another meeting. Magical.
The printer can smell fear.
Per my last sparkle...
Who took the good stapler?
The office plant looks thirsty. So do you.
Somebody's left their mug in the sink again.
Teams says you're 'Away'. I say you're legendary.
The Wi-Fi is having a little nap.
Is it hot in here or is it just my horn?
Hot desking? I've had this spot for ages.

sections.title: Pep talks
lines: You make hard things look easy, {name}.
Neigh-sayers don't get a vote today.
You've handled worse than this before.
Proud of you, {name}. Keep going.
You're the sparkle in this office.
Hard day? You're still doing brilliantly.
Every expert was once a beginner.
You don't have to be perfect, just keep moving.

sections.title: Unicorn facts
lines: Fact: the unicorn is Scotland's national animal.
Fact: a group of unicorns is called a blessing.
Fact: unicorns run on glitter and kindness.
Fact: my horn is 87% sparkle, 13% attitude.
Fact: unicorns never forget a biscuit.

sections.title: Random facts
lines: Fact: honey never goes off. Archaeologists found edible honey in Egyptian tombs.
Fact: octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
Fact: a day on Venus is longer than its year.
Fact: bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
Fact: wombat poo is cube-shaped.
Fact: sea otters hold hands when they sleep.
Fact: the Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm taller in summer.
Fact: cows have best friends and get stressed when apart.
Fact: a cloud can weigh more than a million kilograms.
Fact: sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins.
Fact: there are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
Fact: Scotland has over 400 words for snow.
Fact: a snail can sleep for three years.
Fact: the shortest war in history lasted about 38 minutes.
Fact: humans share about 60% of their DNA with bananas.

sections.title: Office roasts
lines: Someone's checking the biscuit tin again.
That spreadsheet has more tabs than personality.
Somebody found a 2p discrepancy. Cancel Christmas.
Living for a reconciled balance sheet, apparently.
Another email about the fridge. Riveting.
There's a rota for the rota now.
Fresh passive-aggressive Post-it just dropped.
The stationery's restocked. Guard your pens.
The office is managing itself again.
Someone can be heard from three postcodes away.
Someone counted to ten once. Got to eleven.
That phone call has the whole office on it.
Office maths: 2 plus 2 equals overtime.
One counts it, one recounts it, one emails about it.
'Quick chat?' Run.
Reply-all strikes again.
Someone microwaved fish. Stay strong.
The meeting about the meeting has been moved.
Someone's seconds late? Time to act important.
Holiday request 5 weeks ahead? Too short notice, I'm afraid. Denied.
I'm afraid you came in at 8:01. I'm not paying you now.
